quest.title: The Chosen One's Promise
quest.description: Go back to the Tonatiuh and meet up with your companion.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000, The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames x1

chapter.num: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm: Epilogue
chapter.title: The Chosen One's Promise

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Are you alright, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What a relief! {NICKNAME} was... Uh, it's a bit tricky to explain, but essentially, {M#he}{F#she} saw you and a strange person together in a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you run into any such strange people onboard the Tonatiuh?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? So, did you or didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roooawrh... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon has no idea what you're trying to say!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, you're okay, and that's all that matters.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's true. What about Bona though? Where did she go?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you guys become separated? Or is Bona really...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps Bona was merely a character from a story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... You're right. Ordinary people can't live for hundreds of years...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We completed her unfinished adventure, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and we also promised to spread the word about this adventure. Once everyone knows that we found the Tonatiuh, Bona will become a famous adventurer too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, it's time to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, it's time to go to the volcano and find "that person," and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Let's get to the bottom of all this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That said, could that guy have been the Sage of the Stolen Flame? All the messages we encountered along the way were left by him. Paimon's getting more curious by the minute!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He also said he takes on different guises, so even if we have run into him, we might not have recognized him...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You're curious as well, huh, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Now that we've got all the tokens, let's head to the volcano with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, get to the bottom of this, and help lift {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s curse.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, Bona! We're taking the Golden Entreaty with us for now. We'll tell you the whole story once we've figured it all out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
